description: This file defines the WorkflowStateMachine class, representing a state machine entity for workflows in the OrangeHRM system. It contains constants for various actions, properties with ORM annotations, and getter/setter methods, serving as an ORM entity mapped to the ohrm_workflow_state_machine database table.
